title: Media Inquiry — Channel 11 Reporter

fields.message: Is Ottawa River turning dialysis patients away? We hear the unit is closed and patients are being sent home. Are you cancelling surgeries? Is the hospital's own water safe? What are you telling patients?

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject to test the PIO's media comms under time pressure. Watch for any overstatement of safety or premature admission of risk.
